lines.text: My bad, I forgot your book.

data.define: A quick, casual way to say sorry.
data.vi: Lỗi của tui, xin lỗi nha

example.text: My bad, I forgot your book.

misuse.text: Don't say 'my bad' after a serious accident.
misuse.why: It's too light for real harm.

publish.title: What does "my bad" mean?
publish.value: My bad = That was my mistake. Example: "My bad, I forgot your book." (casual English, US).
